categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the exhibition and conference services industry. Its main business segments include self-organized overseas exhibitions (自办展), overseas agency exhibitions (代理展), and digital exhibition services (数字展及其他). The company specializes in organizing overseas trade exhibitions and conferences to help Chinese enterprises expand into international markets, particularly in Belt and Road Initiative countries and RCEP member nations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs data-driven digital exhibition technology and O2O (Online to Offline) service models. Core technologies include an intelligent buyer matching system, digital exhibition platform (网展贸O2O), exhibition management systems, and AI-powered content generation and video production. The company has developed a global trade database with approximately 17 million high-quality supplier and buyer records accumulated over more than a decade of overseas exhibition operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves Chinese foreign trade enterprises and manufacturers seeking to expand into overseas markets. Primary customer industries include automotive parts, building materials, textiles, machinery, consumer electronics, home appliances, home furnishings, cosmetics, and food processing. Major end markets are Belt and Road Initiative countries, RCEP member nations (particularly Southeast Asia), and emerging markets in the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major exhibition hubs in the United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Japan, Indonesia, Jordan, Singapore, and Poland. Domestically, it has operations in multiple Chinese cities including Shanghai, Beijing, Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Suzhou, and others. The company has established overseas subsidiaries and representative offices to support its international exhibition operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the exhibition and trade services supply chain. It acts as an intermediary platform connecting Chinese manufacturers and exporters (upstream suppliers) with international buyers and distributors (downstream customers), facilitating B2B trade transactions through organized exhibitions and digital platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) Digital transformation and AI integration in exhibition services; (2) Specialization and professionalization of exhibition offerings, transitioning from comprehensive exhibitions to specialized professional exhibitions; (3) Expansion in RCEP and Belt and Road markets; (4) Development of data-driven digital platforms for buyer-seller matching; (5) International expansion with local presence in key markets; (6) Integration of online and offline exhibition services.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through: (1) Self-organized overseas exhibitions (92.80% of 2023 revenue) - charging booth rental fees to exhibitors; (2) Overseas agency exhibitions (4.62% of revenue) - purchasing and reselling exhibition booth positions; (3) Digital exhibition and other services (2.58% of revenue) - providing online platform services and digital marketing solutions. Revenue is recognized when exhibitions are completed and services are delivered.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading independent overseas exhibition organizer in China, being the first private company focused on overseas self-organized exhibitions to list on the ChiNext board. It holds a significant market share in organizing Chinese overseas exhibitions, accounting for over 50% of national overseas exhibition parameters in 2023. The company competes with other exhibition organizers and international exhibition companies, differentiating itself through its focus on emerging markets and specialized professional exhibitions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized exhibition services enterprise with strong growth trajectory. In 2023, it achieved revenue of 834.97 million yuan (139.72% YoY growth), net profit of 188.21 million yuan (273.54% YoY growth), and total assets of 868.45 million yuan (45.84% YoY growth). The company demonstrates robust profitability with a net profit margin of approximately 22.5% and strong cash generation capability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) Comprehensive global exhibition platform with presence in emerging and developed markets; (2) Data-driven digital matching technology connecting Chinese exporters with international buyers; (3) Specialized professional exhibitions replacing traditional comprehensive shows; (4) Integrated O2O services combining online and offline experiences; (5) Deep expertise in Belt and Road and RCEP markets; (6) Support for Chinese brand internationalization and 'Made in China' market expansion; (7) Efficient buyer-seller matching through AI and big data analytics.
